_fixture: Cases replayed by `./tools/check-cargo-lanes.py --self-test`. Each file is loaded through the real `tools/cargo_lanes.py` loader, so these expectations cannot drift away from the schema the live manifest is held to.

cases.name: minimal-healthy
cases.why: The smallest manifest the loader accepts must load, so a rejected negative case cannot be explained by a loader that refuses every small manifest.

cases.name: operation-tail-features
cases.why: An operation whose argv tail appends `--features adw-modern` compiles the modern channel while the lane it is labeled with still says v1_4; the floor and routing guards read the lane, so nothing else would notice.
cases.expect_error_contains: `--features` selects packages or features after the lane arguments

cases.name: operation-tail-short-features
cases.why: Cargo's `-F` alias selects the same feature graph as `--features`; accepting the short spelling would let an operation compile the modern channel while its lane still declares the v1_4 baseline.
cases.expect_error_contains: `-F` selects packages or features after the lane arguments

cases.name: operation-tail-package-after-dashdash
cases.why: The same drift past a bare `--` and in the `--package=` spelling: a scan that stops at `--`, or that only compares whole tokens, would accept it.
cases.expect_error_contains: `--package=wayscriber` selects packages or features after the lane arguments
